expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: The favorite/heart button on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' renders as a dark/black circle with a dark heart glyph, while the equivalent button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above is a white circle with a dark heart. The dark-on-dark version has very poor contrast and is hard to see or recognize as a tappable control.
The heart icons act as toggle controls but have no visible label, and the low-contrast variant offers no accessible affordance; state (favorited vs not) is only conveyed by fill color.

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail uses a light grey background while the neighbouring cards use dark backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent and the white time badge on it slightly weaker.

expected.reasoning: None of the reported issues mention the bottom navigation bar or a missing Orders icon; all issues concern card styling and heart button contrast.
